title: H^n restricted to a countably n-rectifiable set is σ-finite
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ and let M ⊆ ℝ^N be countably n-rectifiable in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.1 (Chapter03.CountablyRectifiable n M). That is, M ⊆ M₀ ∪ ⋃_{j∈ℕ} F_j(ℝ^n) with H^n(M₀) = 0 and each F_j : ℝ^n → ℝ^N Lipschitz. Then the measure H^n⌞M = μHE[n].restrict M on ℝ^N is σ-finite.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclidean N)), Chapter03.CountablyRectifiable n M → SigmaFinite ((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict M)
